title: Chintamani Library v2.8.1 — Login Password Change Fix, Eye Toggles & Clean Username Input
releaseNotes: LOGIN PASSWORD CHANGE FIX: Enabled unauthenticated password changing with authoritative bcrypt verification of current password against PostgreSQL
EYE TOGGLES: Added visibility toggle eye icons to Current Password, New Password, and Confirm Password fields in the Change Password dialog
CLEAN USERNAME FIELD: Removed all placeholder text, hints, and labels from the username box on the login screen to keep it completely empty
DIRECT IN-APP INSTALL: In-app APK downloader installs immediately without redirecting to browser
